verdict.rationale: Apify's platform supports Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium/Crawlee-based Actors (apify-docs-4), which are the underlying tools that enable scripted interactions like clicking, filling forms, and scrolling, and SDK docs cover session/proxy management for such crawls (apify-docs-31, apify-docs-34). However, the evidence pack lacks a direct code example or documentation page specifically demonstrating scripted page interactions (click/fill/scroll) prior to content extraction — missing for 10: a concrete interaction-scripting example/tutorial, explicit API for click/type/scroll actions, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
